column4: Original is a statement 'We'll add the corkage to the bill'; JA turns it into a request 'please add it to the bill', changing who does the action.
column5: Thank you. We'll add the corkage to the bill.
column6: ありがとうございます。持ち込み料はお会計に含めておいてください。
column7: Thank you. Please add the corkage fee to the bill.

column4: Original asks whether the service charge is included; Japanese turns it into a statement that it is included.
column5: Certainly. Here you are. Is the service charge included?
column6: かしこまりました。こちらでございます。サービス料は含まれております。
column7: Certainly. Here you are. Service charge is included.

column4: Standalone phrase card: 'I look forward to it' rendered as 'I look forward to hearing from you' (adds 'your contact'), teaching the wrong mapping out of context.
